output_label.base: NGSpice card output (base fit on the K curves, no correction)
output_label.b_shared: NGSpice card output x exp(g_shared) applied in Python
output_label.c_hier: NGSpice card output x exp(g_shared + phi . delta) applied in Python
output_label.c_ml: NGSpice card output x exp(g_shared + phi . delta) applied in Python
output_label.d_scratch: NGSpice card output x exp(g_d) applied in Python (g_d refit on the K curves)
output_label.e_crossinterp: a_C0 NGSpice card output + crossing residual interpolation applied in Python
